analysis_plan.weighting: Uniform over the existing20 conditions and2seeds. Nominal and each stress family are separately reported; no claim of IID lab success probability.
analysis_plan.paired_interval_method: Percentile bootstrap of20 matched configuration clusters; retain both seed outcomes and all paired policies within each sampled cluster.
analysis_plan.interval_interpretation: Descriptive scenario-resampling intervals for this fixed sensitivity suite, not population-level hardware/generalization bounds. Two seeds provide limited sampling uncertainty. Degenerate bootstrap intervals do not establish equivalence.
analysis_plan.missing_trials: Report scheduled-denominator success bounds and all missing/invalid cases. Paired inference requires complete condition×seed matches; incomplete contrasts are explicitly partial.
analysis_plan.safety_stop: Preserve observed physical task outcome; report safety stops separately, including after achieved placement.
analysis_plan.early_failure: Do not discard or replace an executed policy failure. Retry only demonstrable infrastructure failure before any policy command, with explicit linked attempt metadata.
analysis_plan.freeze_policy: Do not tune thresholds, cases or comparisons after observing policy outcomes. Any amendment creates a new campaign id/hash.

collisions.observability: Partial pad/environment forces and reported events; no whole-robot collision-free certification.

scenario_success_interval.method: Bootstrap configuration clusters, retaining both sampling seeds; descriptive sensitivity-suite uncertainty, not a hardware/population confidence bound

limitations: This fixed perturbation suite does not estimate a natural deployment distribution.
Only two sampling seeds per configuration are planned; scenario-resampling intervals do not establish policy equivalence.
Teacher tactile inputs are uncalibrated proxies; teacher contrasts are exploratory.
Physical task completion and safety termination are reported separately.
Missing/invalid trials remain in scheduled-denominator bounds and are listed explicitly.
